relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: After 12 weeks of galcanezumab treatment, median monthly headache days (MHDs) decreased 11.5 (IQR 14.0)

key_findings: In 30 patients, galcanezumab reduced monthly headache and migraine days and HIT-6/MIDAS scores at 12 and 24 weeks.
Treatment satisfaction was higher than with other preventive therapies and correlated with reductions in headache burden.
